SELECT (SELECT x FROM t GROUP BY x ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT x FROM t GROUP BY x) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT x FROM t GROUP BY x) AS member
SELECT (SELECT max(x) FROM t GROUP BY x%3 HAVING max(x)>?1 ORDER BY max(x) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT x FROM t WHERE x>?1 GROUP BY x HAVING x>0) AS hit
SELECT (SELECT sum(x) FROM t WHERE x>?1) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT sum(x) FROM t WHERE x>?1) AS hit, 7 IN (SELECT sum(x) FROM t WHERE x>?1) AS member
SELECT (SELECT max(x) FROM t WHERE 0) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT max(x) FROM t WHERE 0) AS hit, 7 NOT IN (SELECT max(x) FROM t WHERE 0) AS member
SELECT (SELECT NULL FROM t GROUP BY x) AS v, NULL IN (SELECT x FROM t GROUP BY x) AS member, 7 NOT IN (SELECT NULL FROM t GROUP BY x) AS absent
SELECT (SELECT x FROM t WHERE x>?1 GROUP BY x LIMIT 1 OFFSET 99) AS v, EXISTS(SELECT x FROM t WHERE 0 GROUP BY x) AS hit
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT x FROM t) q WHERE x>?1) AS v
SELECT (SELECT missing FROM t GROUP BY x) AS invalid
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT missing FROM t GROUP BY x) AS invalid
